name: @twiza/photo-embed
description: Drains claim_photo_embed_jobs: computes a CLIP ViT-B/32 image embedding (512-d, L2-normalised) for every 'before' report photo missing one (photos.embedding) and records it (complete_photo_embed_job). Feeds near-duplicate detection and 'similar reports' for moderation. Runs on a GitHub Actions runner, not a Supabase Edge Function — running a model on a cold Edge worker would blow its ~2s CPU budget, same class of problem as magick-wasm / Satori on this project.
